title: Without AP/AR Data access, New and Edit Customer show neither field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user on a custom role that has Customers → Create & Edit but not View and Manage AP/AR Data.
  • Make sure customer A exists.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Click "Cancel".
  3. Open Edit Customer for customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.
  • Neither "Credit Terms" nor "Credit Limit" shows.
  • The window looks as it did before the release.

Step 2:

  • The window closes.

Step 3:

  • Neither "Credit Terms" nor "Credit Limit" shows (as Edit Customer today).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S5-N1: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, New Customer and Edit Customer show neither Credit Terms nor Credit Limit (as Edit Customer today).”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “The Credit Terms and Credit Limit fields on New Customer and Edit Customer, and the Credit Terms field on New Vendor and Edit Vendor, are governed by 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', as the existing Edit fields are.”
  • S11-R5: “New Customer now shows Credit Terms (prefilled with the default, COD for existing shops) and Credit Limit to users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'. Users without it see New Customer as before.”
  • S11-N2: “Users without 'Settings → Finance' see no new Settings item; users without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' see no new customer fields.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
